---
title: "Variability of LLM performance across related sub-tasks"
claim: "LLM Performance on related sub-tasks is highly variable."
---

**LLM performance on related sub-tasks is highly variable.**

LLMs generally have much smaller correlations in their ability to successfully complete similar tasks than humans.

- @dreyfuss2025human find that, for a given aggregate SAT score, humans have much larger variations across subjects than LLMs.
